0.name: TEXT_JOBREL500GETGLASSAGAIN_00374_ARDASHIR_000_000
0.description: Another anima glass? I could swear I saw you using the one I gave you not long ago.

1.name: TEXT_JOBREL500GETGLASSAGAIN_00374_ARDASHIR_000_001
1.description: If they were more easily crafted I would gladly offer you another, but sadly that is not the case. That said, you are more than welcome to a replacement when you are truly in need.

3.name: TEXT_JOBREL500GETGLASSAGAIN_00374_ARDASHIR_000_011
3.description: No need to fret. I have prepared another as a safety precaution. With so much at stake, one can never be too careful.

5.name: TEXT_JOBREL500GETGLASSAGAIN_00374_ARDASHIR_000_020
5.description: If anything should happen to it, pray come and speak with me. I shall see to having another prepared for you.

6.name: TEXT_JOBREL500GETGLASSAGAIN_00374_ARDASHIR_000_030
6.description: Are you certain? I imagine tracking the anima's progress will be difficult without it.

7.name: TEXT_JOBREL500GETGLASSAGAIN_00374_ARDASHIR_000_031
7.description: Well, let me know should you change your mind.
